answer: Each agent must lock a unique jade bond inside a time-locked vault that only releases after the agent proves continuous maintenance of a private interaction island: a local subgraph of signed peer messages hashed into a rolling Merkle root. Random challenges demand a jade inclusion proof for a past edge chosen by the challenger. A Sybil attacker must keep a full live island for every fake identity and pay the vault lock for each, making mass identity creation linear in both storage and capital cost.
